name: Turing Labs Inc.
long_description: Turing Labs built the Innovation-led Growth Operating System for food and beverage and personal care companies. Marketing and R&D bring a business problem and leave with the ideas worth launching, formulas their R&D can build faster, and the margin to fund what’s next. Backed by Y-combinator, Insight Partners, and Eric Ries, the AI platform is domain trained with product development specific agents. Customers include Kraft Heinz, Tesco, Unilever, The J.M. Smucker Co., Mondelez, Grupo Bimbo, Herdez, CMI Foods, Kalsec, and several global CPGs and suppliers.
one_liner: AI platform built for CPGs like Kraft and Unilever to optimize…
